# Everything the executor installs from PyPI, by version and hash (pip --require-hashes): the build
# backend and the qq packages' third-party dependencies. Nothing unpinned runs before the push
# credential is minted, so nothing unpinned can plant code that later runs with it.
# The runner is ubuntu-24.04 x86_64 with CPython 3.14 (rpds-py is a binary wheel).
# To update: pip download --only-binary=:all: --no-deps the new versions for that target and
# sha256sum them; `pip check` in action.yml fails if a qq pin bump needs something not listed here.
